_about: Rear (bellhousing) face, y=0. Face coords x across (+ passenger), z above the crank centreline.
bell_src: [spec] GM V8 bellhousing pattern (Chevy Power / jalopyjournal): bolts (+/-7.800, .440), (+/-7.800, 4.200), (+/-4.100, 7.020); the (0, 9.220) hole of the pattern falls on the block's top edge and is not drilled on the BBC. 3/8-16 tapped.

flange.src: [est] lower ears with bosses for the bottom bell bolts (1" tapped) and dowels; photos 431/435 show the rail flaring out at the rear

seal.src: [spec] Fel-Pro 2920 one-piece seal: OD 5.125, ID 4.245; bore depth and clearance [est]; lower half is in the rear main cap (photo 435)
